chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Carrying reeds on the road; Vido Musso takes the sixes
summary: He travelled with several boxes of reeds, and Vido Musso walked off with three boxes of number sixes.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: When I used to go on the road, I used to take on one nighters, I used to take four and five

S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC.
WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

boxes of reeds. Because if I'm going on the road anywhere for like three months or I'm going to be out there for a little while, I got to play theater dates, I go down to -- get me a half a dozen boxes.
In case I didn't get to Chicago where I could buy the same (inaudible), because some of those little towns didn't carry a five or six.
And I used to carry reeds just for -- I'm gonna see somebody out there that's been on the road a long time. I know they come to me and ask me, Teddy, you got any reeds.
So I just carry like --
I was playing the Chicago Theater, and Benny and them come through there with Vido Musso, and (inaudible).
I was on a (bill) theater downtown like the Paramount here. In Chicago, there's big theater (inaudible) Chicago.
We was playing there with Chick. And I'm on the stage up on the end. I look up and there's Vido Musso standing there in the wings.
He say, "Hey, you got any reeds?" I say,
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
"Yeah, they up in my dressing room." So he ran up -- I had three boxes of number sixes. I never used number sixes. Five and a half is high as I would go.
So that's all this fella had in this town, so I just took it. I say I'll give them to somebody else.
And (so inaudible) Vido come in and he went up to the dressing room and looked in my case. When I went up there, (he say inaudible), "I see you."
"See you in New York." And he took all three boxes of sixes. Took all three boxes of reeds. That's about two dozen a box or a dozen in a box.
Yeah. Were you --
I told him, "You can have those things."
He say, "I'm going to pay you." I say, "No, forget it." Because I don't be using no reeds that (inaudible). I just took them because the guy didn't have (any inaudible).
I was in that little town, he didn't have

any. I say, "Give me those. I can shave them down." Just in case I needed them.
